messages:
alex: Morning poll: imagine semver as breakfast cereal. Which one are you? MajorFlakes (breaking changes), MinorMuesli (features), PatchPuffs (bugfixes). Cast votes with emoji. Bonus: drop the worst YAML you saw today. :cereal_box:

marie: MajorFlakes for dramatic impact. I once found a version `v1.0.0-alpha.0+build..` in prod. Felt like archaeology. :scream:

jay: PatchPuffs for me :+1: — safety first. Also this gem I rescued (not mine):```yaml
service:
  version: 'v1..2'  # two dots, bold move
  enabled: yes
``` Parser compatibility: 0%

sam: MinorMuesli — new features keep the job interesting. But saw someone drop `apiVersion: 1.0` in a YAML that expected semver. Instant headache.

ops-bot: heads-up: attempted publish of package with version `1.0.0-rc~~` blocked by registry policy. Please fix and try again. :robot_face:

marie: Also got a YAML file today that was entirely tabs. The YAML parser wept. :sob:

alex: Tally so far -> MajorFlakes:1, MinorMuesli:1, PatchPuffs:1. It's a three-way tie. Tie-breaker: best compiler meme gif wins the unofficial team mascot. Drop your gifs.

jay: https://giphy.com/gifs/compiler-memes-fake-link :laughing:

sam: I formally propose PatchPuffs mugs if we ever do swag. :mug:

marie: Also small PSA: when in doubt, bump the patch. Your coworkers will thank you later. :pray:

alex: Agreed. Thanks for the chaos and the memes, team. Will compile results and maybe make a sticker. :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
